A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same AVA-VLA research work, with readable text, equations, figures, tables and complete Appendices A–E. All appendix pages are identical.

before.justification: v3 reports original AVA-VLA experiments on LIBERO and CALVIN (Tables 1–2), real-world robot experiments (Figure 3), and additional robustness and ablation results in Appendix D.

after.justification: v4 retains these original simulation, real-world, robustness and ablation results unchanged, including Tables 1–2, Figure 3 and Appendix D.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same recurrent-state construction, Active Visual Attention module, state-based initialization, training losses and inference procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same LIBERO, LIBERO+, CALVIN and Mobile ALOHA tasks, including the same perturbation scenarios and four real-world task suites.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout, including Tables 1–2 and 6 and the real-world comparison against UniVLA and OpenVLA-OFT in Figure 3.

E3.justification: The LIBERO policy settings, CALVIN ABC→D split, metrics, training budgets, matched-training control and real-world trial counts are unchanged.

E4.justification: The backbone, module and loss ablations, token-pruning analysis, matched-training comparison, robustness tests, attention visualizations and failure cases are retained unchanged in Sections 4.3–4.4 and Appendices D–E.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version adds run or seed information, uncertainty intervals, error bars or significance tests relative to the other.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match. For example, Table 1 retains LIBERO averages of 98.0% and 98.2%, and Table 2 retains the CALVIN average length of 4.65. No result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: The POMDP formulation, belief-state interpretation and mathematical definitions in Equations 1–14 are identical. No derivations, assumptions or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same novelty, performance and applicability claims. The abstract is reflowed without changing its wording.

C2.justification: The explanations of component complementarity, attention selectivity and robustness are unchanged. Appendix E retains the same limitations concerning accumulated state-estimation errors, belief drift and precision-sensitive failures.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, data-collection descriptions and project-access information remain unchanged. The new funding acknowledgement supplies no additional technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: All 65 references are retained, and Section 2 and Appendix C preserve the same research positioning. Reference movement results solely from layout reflow.

P1.justification: v4 adds an Acknowledgements section crediting Beijing Natural Science Foundation grant L247025 and updates the version/date stamp. The scientific prose and remaining document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The abstract's indentation and line wrapping change, and the acknowledgement shifts the references across PDF pages 9–11. All figures, tables and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 adds funding attribution and makes small formatting changes, while retaining identical methods, evidence, reproducibility details and limitations. The acknowledgement improves attribution completeness but does not produce a meaningful overall quality difference.
